notes: P19 is the old binary in every P20 A/B comparison.
Original case tolerance, target, scaling, null detection and default exact certificate are retained.
The private BLR shim alters CNTL(7) only on active BLR objects; exact counts use BLR=0 and are unchanged.
BLR experimental thresholds are in shim logs. Public FactorOptions still reports its unmodified default 1e-10.
BLR 1e-6 smoke on syn-near-singular-real-1e4 falls back to full precision; no million-row BLR fallback occurred.
BLR screening has two runs per setting and does not cover all run positions equally; all three settings are rejected.
The bounded final variant bypasses its register path for m=1/2 after the extra small-shape microbenchmark exposed a regression.
Microbenchmark speedups are not full-solve speedups. All prototypes share numerical test inputs.
SLEPc uses the P19 best tested profiles. No SLEPc options were unused.
Every repetition and original outlier is retained. No claim against every open-source implementation.
